h: Tacha tells Big Brother Naija organisers what they must do to win viewers back
p: Former housemate Tacha has reportedly given the organisers of Big Brother Naija her advice on how to win back viewers. Her comments are said to have sparked a conversation among fans of the reality show.
more: Fans have been sharing their own views on the show online.
